notes.title: Patch - May 2022
notes.notes:
Two small bugs have been reported and fixed in this update.
Bug 1 - constant adding of same journal entry when talking to the kids in the street
Bug 2 - semi-crash when trying to give items to guards in Letize

While neither of these two bugs was serious, we wanted to ensure a smoother experience for you.

notes.title: Bug fix October 26th
notes.notes:
Some more minor bugs were fixed. No major impact on the game but, again, to ensure a smoother experience.

Journal entry appearing too late with Maurice and Lionel - fixed
Librarian not always ready to discuss your book needs - fixed

notes.title: Patch 1, October 22 2021
notes.notes:
A minor bug has been detected and reported by one player. Had no influence on the game itself but we've fixed it to make for a smoother experience.

Bug - during conversation with Kimley, the same journal entry could get added multiple times - FIXED

notes.title: Release date for Trouble Hunter Chronicles
notes.notes:
The game is finally finished!

It's been tested and stress tested so we hope you'll have a bug free experience but enough is enough and we've set a release date - next weekend!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38310736/1f55fba86a08299a003347ca5fcc372008947647.jpg[/img]

Sunday, October 17th. PC version, both for Windows and Linux, will be available right here on Steam! The steam version features achievements designed to make the adventure game even more challenging!

If you're interested in a MAC version you'll need to check our [url=http://troublehunterchronicles.com]website[/url] on the release day for more information.

Make sure to pack your equipment, sharpen your puzzle solving skills and get ready for some trouble hunting next weekend!

notes.title: Release date
notes.notes:
After several months of hard work we've finally caught up with all the artwork in the game! Most of it is finished and a lot of the existing artwork has been updated from the first versions.

We're close to having Trouble Hunter Chronicles released and are now working on cutscenes (yes, just like in good old adventure games of yore we'll have some cutscenes), finishing the few remaining pieces of artwork and testing the game!

Not ready to set a date in stone yet but it should definitely be this fall.
We're also adding a few last minute surprises to the game which we hope you'll like! Stay tunes and, if you haven't yet, wishlist the game!

notes.title: Progress update!
notes.notes:
We're working on Trouble Hunter Chronicles and have recently inserted a new NPC into the game. You can see how we test the background animation and interaction in the clip.

[previewyoutube=QfZmDI-tadM;full][/previewyoutube]

Life issues sometimes get in the way and slow down our progress so we're moving the release date to late Spring or possibly Summer. It may not be what you want to hear but creating all the art takes a lot of time.

We'll keep you posted on the exact release date.
